name: Cloudflare Workers KV Free
free_limit: Workers Free KV: 1 GB stored, 100K key reads/day and 1K each of key writes, deletes and list requests/day
watch_out: Read/write/delete/list limits are separate, reset at 00:00 UTC, and exceeding any quota causes that operation to fail. Dashboard and Wrangler operations count toward limits; missing-key reads also count. No KV egress charge, but Workers requests and CPU quotas are separate.
